label: Common uncaused esse-cause of received bearers implies rooted closed collections
description: Sole-premise strength comparison on the exact actual esse-cause dictionary, constructive. Any member of a closed collection with no root is received, so the common cause causes it and closure brings the common cause in; being uncaused it is a root. Controls (6) and (7) witness strictness. With the previous argument this is a second support option for CCR, through premises A and B jointly; it adds no warrant beyond that of A, B and no self-causation.
